# GitHub repo settings (copy into GitHub UI)

GitHub does not read this file automatically. Update these on:

## Description (350 chars max)

```
Local-first Python + Streamlit app for gig delivery drivers (Australia): gross vs net pay, fuel & odometer logging, ATO km estimates, shift analytics. Privacy-first — your CSV stays on your machine. MIT.
```
